source.title: The Opportunity - Product Management track
source.scope: U.S. federal early-career digital-service fellowship track guidance
source.sourceQualifier: Work in this track may include:
orderedTasks: Contributing to the end-to-end development of a digital product or service, from concept to delivery
Using agile and lean approaches to product management
Conducting qualitative and quantitative research to understand user needs and product performance
Collaborating on product vision, roadmapping, and metric development

mappingCondition: Confirm the planned role concerns digital product or service discovery, user-needs research, prioritisation and requirements with delivery teams, and evaluation of product outcomes.
